version.changelog: Address security-audit findings: disclose the api passthrough in the access-scope and description text, warn on irreversible connection deletion, add response data-minimization guidance, and correct app-specific auth and request-body notes

llm.summary: This Salesforce skill is a disclosed CRM integration that can read and modify Salesforce data through Maton, with clear user-approval and credential-handling safeguards.

dimensions.detail: Network access, Bash use, and Salesforce account access are proportionate for a Salesforce API skill, and the instructions limit raw HTTP fallback to environments where the CLI cannot be installed.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation uses the external Maton CLI via npm or Homebrew and requires a Maton account and Salesforce OAuth connection, all of which are disclosed in the skill text.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The artifact discloses that documented endpoints are the intended surface while the Maton API passthrough may reach other authorized Salesforce endpoints; it repeatedly requires read-first behavior and explicit user confirmation for writes.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: OAuth tokens, API keys, and SDK sessions may be stored in local credential stores or session state, but the skill explicitly warns not to print, export, search, persist, or transmit credentials outside api.maton.ai.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's Salesforce query, object, CRUD, composite, and raw API capabilities match its stated CRM administration purpose, but they can affect business records and should be treated as high-impact.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this only for Salesforce CRM administration. Use the narrowest Salesforce scopes available, prefer sandbox or read-only access for risky work, verify the Maton profile and connection ID before use, and require specific confirmation before any create, update, delete, composite, or raw API write call.
llm.findings: [SDI-4] expected: The artifact does contain both a documented-endpoints support statement and a disclosure that the passthrough can reach any endpoint the Salesforce connection permits. I downgraded this to a guidance note because the broad passthrough is disclosed in the description and security section, tied to the Salesforce integration purpose, and covered by explicit confirmation rules for all write and batch operations.
